levels.label: Supported target
levels.allowed_claim: The prototype recognizes a repository with package.json and pnpm-lock.yaml as a supported Node/pnpm target.
levels.forbidden_inference: Other ecosystems are supported or the setup is globally installed.

levels.label: Preview-first mutation
levels.allowed_claim: The plan names a reversible repository-local config change before apply.
levels.forbidden_inference: The tool silently installs or commits anything.

levels.label: Refusal and rollback
levels.allowed_claim: A second plan refuses an existing owned config and the saved rollback removes only that config.
levels.forbidden_inference: Rollback can restore arbitrary unrelated repository state.

levels.label: Broader support
levels.allowed_claim: The current prototype's supported ecosystem is explicitly narrow.
levels.forbidden_inference: The setup inspector covers every Quality Runner ecosystem.

levels.label: External release
levels.allowed_claim: Deployment and external publication remain unverified.
levels.forbidden_inference: The setup case is live on GitHub, portfolio, or Handshake.
